newsitem.title: USA: Acceptance Insurance raises '96 EPS view.
newsitem.headline: Acceptance Insurance raises '96 EPS view.

text.p: Acceptance Insurance Cos Inc said Tuesday it raised its 1996 earnings forecast to $2.01 a share from $1.63 previously.
Earlier, it reported earnings for the first nine months of 1996 of $1.64 a primary share, compared with a year-ago loss of $0.10 a share.
In 1995, the company earned $0.28 a share, which included $20.1 million in pretax charges to strengthen prior year loss reserves.

"We are pleased with the company's performance during the first nine months of 1996," Kenneth Coon, chief executive officer of Acceptance Insurance Cos, said in a statement. "The Crop Division is having an excellent year and the Property and Casualty Division continues to make the changes necessary in order to improve long term profitability. We look forward to 1997."
The company added that its book value was $13.35 a share as of September 30.
